exposure: management of the third stage of labor (including prophylactic synthetic oxytocin use, controlled cord traction, uterine massage, and cord milking)
outcome: timing of umbilical cord clamping practice
management of the third stage of labor (including prophylactic synthetic oxytocin use, controlled cord traction, uterine massage, and cord milking)
cohort: 95 midwives from 48 birth units in Sweden participated in a telephone survey about their clinical practices.
finding: All midwives preferred late cord clamping for full-term infants, but significant variability was observed in practices related to prophylactic oxytocin administration, controlled cord traction, uterine massage, cord milking, and cord clamping in preterm infants.
